blocks.text: Greentree Village, in the City of Burnaby, is a real estate board name for a planned residential enclave near Canada Way and Wayburne Drive, beside the BCIT Burnaby campus and the approach to Deer Lake and Burnaby Hospital. It is not an official City neighbourhood.

Homes for sale in Greentree Village are mainly townhouses and some houses inside the planned streets, with a quieter internal layout than the arterials around it. Deer Lake Park and the civic precinct are a short trip east. Metrotown and Brentwood are reached along Willingdon and Canada Way.

Buses on Canada Way and Willingdon connect to Metrotown Station and Brentwood Town Centre Station. Nearby public schools include those in the central Burnaby family, including schools feeding toward Burnaby Central or Moscrop Secondary. Check the SD41 school locator.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Greentree Village

items.t: Greentree Village (City of Burnaby Greentree Village Community Plan, Manager's Report No. 72, Rezoning #1/72, dated Nov 6, 1972): a roughly 50-acre planned site south of Canada Way behind BCIT, bounded by Wayburne Drive (W), Woodsworth Street (N), Forest Lawn Cemetery (E) and Moscrop Street (S), planned for about 450 units at 12 units per acre. That 1972 plan is the subdivision document for this area: the village streets (Garden Grove Drive, Fernglen Drive/Place, Cedarglen Place, Laurelwood Place, Elmgrove Drive, Driftwood Place, Village Drive) are its built fabric, not a current lot offering, and no lot sizes, lot counts for sale, or prices are stated — none exists as an offering.

How the plan was built out (no recount): the village was delivered as multiple strata townhouse phases, each phase its own strata corporation. Detached houses also sit on village streets; they are single-family homes, not a land offering.
Surrounding and in-village detached lots: fee-simple single-family houses ring the strata phases and sit on some village streets — the freehold side of the pocket.

The village streets are Garden Grove Drive, Fernglen Drive/Place, Cedarglen Place, Laurelwood Place, Elmgrove Drive, Driftwood Place and Village Drive.
Roads and transit, corrected pocket: Canada Way is the arterial along the pocket's north side.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Greentree Village

items.t: Small-scale housing (for the fee-simple house lots around Greentree, not the strata townhouses): R1 lots can have 3 units on lots up to 280 m², 4 on larger lots, and 6 on lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent bus stop, with a minimum lot of 10 m wide and 281 m². Lots with two or more main units can be stratified, and the zone allows houses, duplexes, multiplexes, rowhouses and secondary suites.

Strata rules: the Form B must be provided within 7 days for at most $35 plus 25¢ a page; each Greentree phase is its own strata with its own Form B, reserve fund and depreciation report. Stratas with 5 or more lots need a depreciation report every 5 years, at least 10% of the budget must go into the reserve, rental bans are void (short-term rentals can still be limited), and only 55+ age bylaws are valid, so a "45+" listing line isn't enforceable.

If a parcel is in the ALR: subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified. On ALR land the main house can be up to 500 m², a suite is allowed only inside it, and an extra residence can be up to 90 m² (186 m² on parcels over 40 ha).

faq.a: In the V5G pocket south of Canada Way behind BCIT, at the west edge of Deer Lake — bounded by Wayburne Drive, Woodsworth Street, Forest Lawn Cemetery and Moscrop Street under the City's 1972 Greentree Village Community Plan.

faq.q: Can I buy a vacant lot in Greentree Village?
faq.a: None that I know of. The village was finished in the 1970s: phases of strata townhouses plus detached houses on the village streets.
Run the exact address in the SD41 locator.

faq.q: How many homes can a surrounding R1 house lot hold?
faq.a: 3 units on lots up to 280 m², 4 on larger lots, and 6 on lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent-transit stop; minimum lot width 10 m and minimum lot area 281 m² for SSMUH lots. That rule does not redevelop a strata townhouse parcel.

faq.q: Where is Greentree Village in Burnaby?
faq.a: On Burnaby's south slope around Marlborough Avenue and Sussex Avenue, near École Marlborough Elementary, west of Metrotown. "Greentree Village" is the MLS® area name and also the local name for the townhouses.

faq.q: Which school is in Greentree Village?
faq.a: École Marlborough Elementary (K–7), 6060 Marlborough Ave — a French Immersion program school; Immersion entry is application-based, and the catchment for any specific address must be checked in the SD41 School Locator.
